title: statusline r21 UX: the marker spans 2 of 7 wiring outcomes
description: Round 21. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Defect: a boolean not-installed marker cannot distinguish success, deliberate skips (refusal, decline, non-interactive no-flag), and failures — the primary automation question (did it wire?) has no defined answer and the name conflates skip with failure. Citations verified: contract:187, :162, :173. Proposed: resolved-candidate (the wiring outcome is an enumerated member — installed, refused-existing-entry, declined, not-offered-non-interactive, withdrawn-read-failure, failed-write — success affirmative, skips and failures distinct; every install fixture asserts its expected member by exact match).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the wiring outcome is an enumerated member spanning the full path space — installed, refused-existing-entry, declined, not-offered-non-interactive, withdrawn-read-failure, failed-write — success affirmative, skips and failures distinct; every install-offer fixture asserts its expected member by exact match. Revision: Install bullet + criterion.
